_comment: Integrity manifest. The trusted runner re-hashes these files before every run and refuses to proceed on mismatch. Any change to official files requires a new user-approved commit and manifest update.
_frozen_runner_note: Pinned at freeze-candidate v1.0.2 on 2026-08-28. Every runner subcommand verifies these hashes AND this pin before producing any output; under the cooperative trust model this makes accidental or self-modified drift self-defeating. The absolute guarantee is external: git history + this manifest let anyone re-verify the exact bytes. Authorized harness changes follow the re-freeze procedure: user-approved pin update + full re-validation + re-audit.
